regisztracio.jelszo_sugo: Any characters work; length matters, not complexity.

szervezet.nev_sugo: No legal company details needed. You can rename it later.

onboarding1.alcim: Give a website, or describe it in a few sentences. We'll help you put the basics together.
onboarding1.nev_sugo: No legal company details needed. If you leave it blank, we'll suggest a name based on the source you provide.
onboarding1.weboldal_sugo: We'll process the text from the page you provide — this isn't a full site crawl.
onboarding1.leiras: What do you do, for whom, and what sets you apart?
onboarding1.leiras_pl: A few sentences is enough. e.g. Artisan bakery in Debrecen, for families and offices…
onboarding1.arculat_leiras: If you provide it, the AI will also prepare a visual identity draft for your communication materials. This will be your brand's rulebook — it doesn't change the system interface.
onboarding1.arculat_weboldal_is: Use the website as a source
elonezet.alcim: This is what the system sees about you. Updates live.
onboarding1.err_forras_cim: We couldn’t reach this page right now.
onboarding1.err_forras_szoveg: The page may be unavailable or protected. Try again, or paste your intro text — your input is intact.
onboarding1.err_ai_cim: The AI service is unavailable right now.
onboarding1.err_ai_szoveg_leiras: You can use your description as the summary without AI, and retry anytime. Your input is intact.
onboarding1.err_ai_szoveg_weboldal: Try again later, or paste your intro text and continue without AI. Your input is intact.
onboarding1.folyamat_megj: The AI works from your source — the result will be editable.
onboarding1.forras_weboldal_megj: Based on the text of the given page.
onboarding1.nem_teny: The suggestion is not a verified fact — edit it freely.
onboarding1.kerdes_cimke: One question: who do you mostly work for?
onboarding2.alcim: We prepared a few suggestions from what you gave us. All editable — or postpone them.
onboarding2.err_ai_szoveg: Manual input works the same, and what you type is kept.
onboarding2.cel_pl: What do you want to achieve? Multiple goals are fine.
onboarding2.nyelvek_sugo: Your content will be created in these languages. The interface language is independent.
onboarding2.kesobbre_hagyva: Postponed — stays as “Not set” in the profile.
onboarding3.alcim: The system’s tools will use this profile. After approval it moves to your account, editable anytime.
onboarding3.eredet_megj: A source label does not mean the statement is verified or current. An AI suggestion is not a fact. Click the badge to open provenance details.
onboarding3.eredet_sablon: Origin: {src}. Last modified by: {ed}. A source label does not prove correctness.
onboarding3.eredet_ures: This field is still empty — we do not fill it with invented content.
onboarding3.eredet_weboldal: the text of the given website
onboarding3.eredet_ai: AI suggestion from the provided data
onboarding3.arculat_sugo: Your brand’s rules for created content. It does not change the system UI, and its approval is separate from the base data. Without approval it never becomes a production rule.
onboarding3.arc_megtartva: The previously approved version (v{v}) is kept intact — the new draft never overwrites it silently.
onboarding3.arc_betu_iranymutatas: AI direction: {v} — choose an actual font for it.
onboarding3.arc_eredet_forras: A proposal based on your sources — not the full brand identity.
onboarding3.arc_eredet_ai: No existing identity — a proposed new direction; becomes a rule only after approval.
onboarding3.arc_egy_minta: We never derive firm brand rules from a single sample.
onboarding3.arc_ideiglenes: Temporary neutral rendering — not a saved brand rule.
onboarding3.arc_kesobb_hosszu: Postponed — the data is kept but is not applied as an approved rule. The base profile can be approved without it.
onboarding3.arc_nincs_megj: No identity draft yet. The AI drafts one from the sources of step 1 — or postpone it.
onboarding3.hianyzik_megj: Postponed: {list}. This does not block saving.
onboarding3.jovahagyas_megj: Approval concerns this profile only — it is not a publishing or automation permission.
onboarding3.jovahagyas_tiltva: Saving requires a named profile and an accepted activity description.
onboarding3.jovahagyas_hiba_szoveg: All your data is intact — retry the approval. Until then the profile stays a draft.

fiok.bevezeto: Every tool uses this profile. Saved changes take effect immediately; modules will use it on their next run.
fiok.nyelv_megj_rovid: Does not rewrite the profile texts.
fiok.honnan_rovid: The profile was created from the three Onboarding steps, with approval. Since then there is no draft — this is the one authentic profile, right here.
fiok.arc_megj_jovahagyott: Approved {ido} · {ki}. Editing creates a new draft; the approved version stays until you approve the new one.
fiok.arc_megj_egyeb: No approved identity — the draft is a suggestion, not a production rule.
